context.description: Create the Recorder and the status writer

evidence.trustReason: Layer 3 REJECTED. Ran bun test --timeout 60000 test/task/recorder.test.ts: 11 pass, 0 fail, 24 expect calls. Gaps per test case: TC4 (interrupt mid-record leaves stored-and-folded or neither) is VACUOUS: Effect.forkChild schedules the child (effect 4.0.3 forkUnsafe immediate=false) and Fiber.interrupt runs before it starts; interruptUnsafe ends the unstarted fiber, so record never runs and expect(stored.some(...)).toBe(folded) compares false with false; it passes with or without Effect.uninterruptible. TC6 (Queue.sliding(1) burst gives at most one pending write; touch after the run scope closed returns void): no assertion counts writes (an unbounded queue passes), and no test touches after Scope.close. TC5: 'once per committed macrostep' not asserted (only end states polled, no write count); final snapshot, touch rewrite and no write after done are covered. TC13 (SV26): store unchanged and failure asserted, but 'logs the defect' and 'the writer writes nothing more' have no assertion. TC11: 'failed write is logged' not asserted; next-macrostep write covered. Covered: TC1, TC3, TC8 (SV21), TC10, TC12; TC2, TC7, TC9 covered but weak (contention not forced, live clock). Implementation reads correct; tests do not prove it. Fixes in journal/task/T2.4-verify.md.
